title: Transfer selected scope through explicit project association
statement: The Work records Module shall transfer selected scope through explicit project association through its typed maintenance boundary, preserving actual scope, source meaning and safe failure.

what.problem: A copied engineering checkout does not contain private work history, and importing history into the wrong project can create false provenance.
what.desired_outcome: Another local environment can inspect and resume the selected retained work with its original meaning and explicit limits.

why.rationale: SR-076 requires operational preservation; MOD-011 owns the associated store and maintenance activation, while MOD-010 owns admission and result presentation.

stakeholders: Project maintainers and authorized agents relying on retained operational work

conditions: An actor explicitly selects the supported maintenance task, scope, source expectations and destination.

contexts: MOD-011 through IF-003, invoked by MOD-010 through IF-004; engineering definitions remain repository-owned.

how.approach: Use the reviewed MOD-011 maintenance contract: coherent staged scope, explicit project/schema/integrity checks, exclusive activation and attributable recovery outcomes.

how_much.scope: Selected retained supported records and payloads only; no silent merge, universal history retention, source deletion or renewed engineering approval.

acceptance_criteria: Transfer declares source project, retained scope, included artifacts and state identity; the receiving environment can inspect those facts before activation.
A matching project in an empty authorized destination receives the selected scope with the same identities and provenance through the backup/restoration integrity obligations of SR-074/075.

A different project identity, divergent existing history or reused record identity with different content causes a conflict and leaves both histories intact; project-name similarity does not establish identity.
Excluded records or artifacts are visible before reliance, and the receiving result does not claim completeness outside the declared transferable scope.
Transfer leaves the source usable, does not change engineering-model files, and does not silently refresh assessments to the destination checkout revision.
The public maintenance contract identifies preview versus execution, current expectations and actual effects; interrupted activation remains fenced until explicitly reconciled.
assumptions: Required retained source material and supported interpretation information are accessible; failure of that premise is reported explicitly.
constraints: Historical subject/revision provenance remains stable; restoring operational state creates a fresh store incarnation so old mutation tokens cannot be replayed.

sources.basis: Reconcile the existing reviewed maintenance responsibility with explicit REM allocation. This allocation is design intent, not execution or satisfaction evidence.
